message.summary: one paragraph a human can read

humanGateShape.decidedBy: human name, never a bot id

rules: Teammate messages use this object. The channel thread gets a short reading of the same facts.
stage-return and build-result come back to Lead. Lead appends a stage-transition record and then messages the next owner.
humanGate.status may be pending when a bot posts the card. approved or rejected is copied from a human reply. A bot never sets approved.
build-result carries proposedBranch, prUrl, testsPassed, and testsSummary. Lead uses it for the test gate.
